info.text:
Four companies made about 90% of America's baby formula in 2022.
The US price index for baby food and formula rose 31% from 2020 to 2025, including 11.6% in 2022 alone.
In 2022, imports faced tariffs up to 17.5% and were about 2% of US formula. GAO found WIC contract winners' shelf prices rose 1.7%.
Every standard infant formula sold in the US must meet the same FDA nutrient rules, store brands included.
Sources: FTC, BLS, CRS, GAO, FDA, AAP.
News and education, not financial advice.
